changes: Fixed AcoustID connection testing by restoring the missing child-process execFile import required to run fpcalc.
Added an end-to-end Configuration test covering key entry, native-save bridge behavior, persistent storage, fingerprint generation, API response display, and an opt-in live-key check.
Removed all Keychain access from the app to prevent authorization prompts from blocking or hanging startup.
Save the AcoustID key in the user's Application Support folder with account-only permissions; re-enter a previously saved Keychain key once.
Removed the macOS Keychain command-line read that could block behind a system authorization prompt.
Store the AcoustID key in the user's Application Support folder with account-only permissions so it remains available across app updates.
Removed legacy Keychain migration after it was found to stall startup on affected Macs; users need to re-enter an existing key once.
Added regression coverage for native-app startup, key-file errors, environment overrides, and app replacement.
Improved AcoustID error diagnostics, including invalid API key details, malformed request responses, and HTTP 404 endpoint errors.
Added Not Found track duration and metadata editing with automatic Music.app import or optional playlist selection.
Added optional AcoustID audio fingerprint matching with a macOS Keychain-stored API key, connection validation, configuration warnings, and one-track retries.
Added a native macOS menu-bar app with background mode and login startup.
Added configurable macOS notifications for export, scan, and playlist events.
Added an in-app Release Notes page showing the build time.
Search previews now pause Music.app, and search results can be added to Music.app playlists.
Selecting a playlist in Search auto-adds the track after two seconds, verifies it in Music.app, and refreshes the local playlist view.
